description:
Hushfeed v0.52.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Morphe source updates work again. The source index now uses the timestamp format Manager expects. If you saw The remote metadata file is unavailable, refresh the Hushfeed source. You don't need to clear Manager data or change its signing key.

Comment tools adds Hide search suggestions above comments, an independent switch for TikTok's suggested-search banner above the comment count. Comments and Hushfeed's separate search box remain available. It's off by default and needs a restart. Search controls now say which screen they affect, and poll hiding explains that it covers ended results.

Validation: 1490 runtime tests passed locally, plus 251 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no unexpected manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks; use 47.0.3 when patching.

The exact release-derived APK was installed on the S22 with the same signing key and unchanged first-install time. The new switch hides the suggested-search banner while leaving the comment count, close button and composer available. The signed-in account was preserved. The S25 source failure was diagnosed from its Manager log. Its TikTok installation wasn't replaced because its signing key differs from the local test key.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. The downloadable .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
